summary: Comprehensive testing of IdeaRadar light/dark theme toggle and updated 3-tier pricing. All features working correctly. Backend: 23/23 tests passing. Frontend: Theme toggle, pricing page, auth, dashboard, idea detail, saved ideas all verified.

issues: Auth page does not have theme toggle button - uses its own nav without Navbar component. Theme is applied from localStorage but cannot be toggled on auth page. Minor UX issue.
Landing page does not have theme toggle button - uses custom nav instead of Navbar component. User cannot toggle theme from landing page.

action_items: Consider adding theme toggle to Landing page and Auth page navbars for consistent UX across all pages
critical_code_review_comments: Theme toggle implementation is correct: stored in localStorage as 'idearadar_theme', applied via data-theme attribute on documentElement
CSS variables properly switch between :root (dark) and [data-theme='light'] for backgrounds, text, borders
Pricing page correctly shows 3 tiers: Free ($0/forever), Pro ($40/month), Business ($60/month)
Backend POST /api/subscription/upgrade correctly accepts tier='pro' and tier='business' parameters
Default tier when no parameter specified is 'pro' - correct behavior
